setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 sends to a MIDI device and plays pattern 1: four trigs on steps 1-4 (C, D, E, F = MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) in the default C major scale. Channel tasks is open on channel 1 and playback has not started, so no note has played yet.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Output and press K3. Six rows describe the last note channel 1 played: Note (the note, and any chord voices), Vel / Len (velocity and length), Step (the step it came from), Degree (the pattern degree, and what merging made of it), Pitch (the pitch in the scale, and the harmony's pitch if Harmony moved it) and Sent (the note actually sent, or why none was: MUTED or REST). Nothing has played yet, so every row reads NO EVENT and there is no cursor; this screen only displays.
steps.title: Open Output before anything has played

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let the loop run, then tap Play again to stop. Output now shows the last note channel 1 played: Note C3 (MIDI 60), Vel / Len 127 / 1.0 (velocity 127, one step long), Step STEP01 (the step it came from), Degree 0 (the first scale degree), Pitch C3 (the pitch in the scale) and Sent C3 (the note actually sent). Look at the MIDI strip, "MIDI sent in this step", for the notes behind it.
steps.title: Play, then read the rows

steps.caption: Turn E2 or E3 or press K3: nothing changes, because Output has no cursor. Now hold step 2 at (2,4) without tapping it. Step reads STEP02 HELD and the rows show what step 2 plays: Degree +1, Pitch D3 and Sent D3. Note and Vel / Len still show the last note played. Release the step to return to the latest note.
steps.title: Hold a step to see what it plays

steps.caption: Hold step 40 at (8,6), a step with no trig. Every row reads NO EVENT and Step reads STEP40 HELD: a step without a note borrows nothing from the last note played. Release the step to return to the latest note.
steps.title: A step with no note shows NO EVENT

title: Read the latest note on Output
